## Description

Detects the software the deposit uses (Stata, R, Python, MATLAB, SAS, Julia, and others) from `generated/programs-metadata[.tag].csv` (written by [04_list_program_files.sh](#help-04_list_program_files)) and the kernel language of notebooks. It adds any newly found software to the Jira issue's "Software used" checkboxes, and anything that is not a checkbox option to "Software used (other)". Existing values are never removed. The work is done by `tools/jira_update_software.py`.

The Jira ticket is taken from `$jiraticket`, then `config.yml`, then looked up from an openICPSR directory.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/26_update_jira_software.sh <project-dir> [tag]
```

- `project-dir` - Deposit directory (used to inspect `.ipynb` kernels).
- `tag` - Optional suffix of the metadata file.

Standard output carries only the "Software detected: ..." line. The pipelines capture it and pass it to [70_publish_comment.sh](#help-70_publish_comment), so the information reaches Jira even if writing the field fails. The exit code is that of the Python tool; the pipelines append `|| true`.

### Environment Variables

- `jiraticket`, `JIRA_USERNAME`, `JIRA_API_KEY`
